title: A push after the approval changes the preview, so the merged change waits at its wave's own gate

steps.label: main puts the stock prod stacks first in the waves, gates every wave (gate: always), and plywood init writes them again

steps.title: prod-us: keep events for two hours

steps.label: the author pushes one more commit after the approval, and the push waits for the plans recorded at the new head
the merge's first wave job is on the ledger, gated: a gated job records no target, so the wait does not name a stack
the wave holding prod-us waits at its own gate, and nothing applied prod-us

break.note: The push after the approval is an empty commit, so the tree, the preview and its digest stay the same, the approval covers the merge and prod-us applies: the waits check must fail.
